fact: A 2022 ethnographic study of primary care centres in one health district found staff still producing hand-drawn information supports, and a donor-funded computerisation of the information system at one centre was described by a midwife as hard to use.
title: Le Système d'Information Sanitaire au niveau des Etablissements de Soins de Santé Primaires au Maroc : Apport de la Théorie de Luhmann
publisher: Revue Africaine des Sciences Humaines et Sociales
